Locked-off camera, fisheye framing holds. The masked man in the red suit pushes his open gloved palm toward the lens on the beat, pulls it back a little, pushes again, four steady times, head nodding with each push. His other hand slowly slides the wallet fully out of the man's coat pocket. The man in the hat keeps gazing up at the clock, motionless. Mask, gloves and suit unchanged; the crowd behind keeps walking in place. SFX: station echo, footsteps, a distant train hiss, no voices.

Thanks.
